verdict.rationale: Name.com documents a transfer-in flow. The create-transfer endpoint requires the domain name and a valid EPP/auth code, a dedicated external-transfers guide covers moving domains in from another registrar, and transfer progress can be tracked through the `domain.transfer.status_change` webhook. Transfer cost is only implied: the TLD price list returns pricing 'for each supported order type' but never explicitly names transfer fees, and nothing says what happens to remaining registration time. Missing for 10: explicit transfer-in pricing documentation, documentation of how remaining registration time is handled (e.g. a one-year extension), and independent hands-on corroboration of the transfer flow.
